title.zh: 批量处理变得能用了：序号命名、拖动定位、一键分享
title.en: Batches become usable: numbered names, drag to place, share in one tap

changes.zh: 新增：批量导出的文件名可以带序号 —— 支持 {index} 与 {index:03}，起始序号可设；重跑失败项时序号保持不变
changes.en: Added: batch exports can carry a sequence number in file names — {index} or {index:03}, with a configurable start; retrying failed items keeps the original numbers

changes.zh: 新增：批量页可以直接拖动水印位置 —— 双击水印锁定后拖动，点预览区外解锁；可选「统一位置」或「每张独立」
changes.en: Added: drag the watermark directly on the batch preview — double-tap it to lock, tap outside the preview to unlock; choose one position for all images or one per image

changes.zh: 新增：批量处理完成后可以直接分享导出的图片
changes.en: Added: share the exported images straight from the completion dialog

changes.zh: 优化：首页入口卡片适配小屏与平板 —— 小屏上第三张卡片不再被压扁到点不中
changes.en: Improved: home entry cards adapt to small phones and tablets — on small screens the third card is no longer squashed out of reach

changes.zh: 优化：预览缓存张数按可用内存自动决定，低内存机型更稳
changes.en: Improved: the preview cache now follows available memory, which is steadier on low-memory devices

changes.zh: 优化：处理完成弹窗里的「分享」移到左下角，与「好」同一行
changes.en: Improved: the share action in the completion dialog now sits at the bottom left, level with OK

changes.zh: 修复：在设置里点「导出」会崩溃（一个正则表达式在本机系统上被当成非法写法）
changes.en: Fixed: tapping Export in Settings crashed the app (a regular expression the platform rejected)

changes.zh: 修复：连续快速换图时，预览或导出可能仍然是上一张
changes.en: Fixed: switching images quickly could leave the preview or the export showing the previous one

changes.zh: 修复：对超大图片做隐藏水印检测时会闪退，现在会给出具体原因
changes.en: Fixed: hidden-watermark detection crashed on very large images, and now explains what went wrong

changes.zh: 修复：从系统设置改完「安装未知应用」权限返回后，设置页状态不刷新
changes.en: Fixed: after changing the install-unknown-apps permission in system settings, the app's own state did not refresh

title.zh: 预览不再缩水：原图分辨率，而且跟手
title.en: A preview that no longer shrinks: full resolution, and it keeps up

changes.zh: 优化：预览改用原图分辨率 —— 此前最长边被压到 720，看着比导出结果糊
changes.en: Improved: the preview now renders at full image resolution (it used to be downscaled to 720px, so it looked softer than the export)

changes.zh: 优化：拖动字号 / 角度 / 密度 / 透明度时更跟手 —— 每帧只重画水印，不再整块重拷底图
changes.en: Improved: dragging size, rotation, density or opacity is far more responsive - only the watermark is redrawn each frame

changes.zh: 优化：打开图片时先显示低清占位、再无缝换成高清，首屏不再长时间空白
changes.en: Improved: a low-res placeholder appears immediately and is then seamlessly replaced by the full-resolution image

changes.zh: 修复：水印被画到图片外面（预览比导出多出四周留白，边缘水印会溢出）
changes.en: Fixed: watermarks could be drawn outside the image (the preview has letterbox padding that the export does not)

changes.zh: 修复：关掉「自动强度」后，自己导出的图片反而检测不出来（检测端默认强度与导出不一致）
changes.en: Fixed: images exported with auto-strength turned off could not be detected (the detector default did not match the export)

changes.zh: 修复：导出失败时，相册里残留一条打不开的空白条目
changes.en: Fixed: a failed export left an unopenable empty entry in the gallery

changes.zh: 修复：隐藏水印内容过长时会被整段丢弃（现在按字符截断，不会把 emoji 切成半个）
changes.en: Fixed: over-long invisible-watermark payloads were dropped entirely (now truncated, without cutting an emoji in half)

changes.zh: 修复：隐藏水印的两处边界 —— 内容为空时被误报「检测到水印」；内容以 B64: 开头时写进去读不出来
changes.en: Fixed: two invisible-watermark edge cases - an empty payload was reported as detected, and payloads starting with "B64:" could not be read back

changes.zh: 修复：签名校验的两处隐患 —— 长度字段只覆盖低 8 位；校验失败时静默返回全零，可能与有效签名混淆
changes.en: Fixed: two signature-check weaknesses - only the low 8 bits of the length field were covered, and a failed check silently returned all zeros

changes.zh: 修复：隐藏水印含控制字符时，XMP 元数据变成非法 XML，别的软件可能整包丢弃
changes.en: Fixed: control characters made the XMP metadata invalid XML, which other software may discard entirely

changes.zh: 修复：大尺寸图片检测隐藏水印时可能因内存不足而失败
changes.en: Fixed: detecting watermarks in large images could fail on memory

changes.zh: 变更：签名状态文案由「已验证 · 本应用签发」改为「通过内置密钥校验」—— 内置密钥是公开可查的，原措辞给了超出实际能力的信任感
changes.en: Changed: the signature status now reads "Passed built-in key check" instead of "Verified - issued by this app"; the built-in key is public, so the old wording over-promised

changes.zh: 变更：隐藏水印嵌入强度由 4 档缩为 2 档 —— 原来 3、4 档受上限限制，实际效果与 2 档没有区别
changes.en: Changed: invisible-watermark strength went from 4 steps to 2 - steps 3 and 4 were capped and behaved identically to step 2

title.zh: 补完两处遗漏，更新说明改为在线获取
title.en: Two follow-up fixes, and the changelog now comes from the web

changes.zh: 修复：手机竖拍照片的水印仍偏小约三分之一（EXIF 旋转后基准尺寸的行列取反了，上一版没修透）
changes.en: Fixed: watermarks on portrait photos were still about a third too small (EXIF rotation swapped the baseline dimensions - the previous fix did not go far enough)

changes.zh: 修复：批量页连续滑动切换图片时，预览的水印大小偶尔按上一张照片的基准渲染
changes.en: Fixed: in batch mode the preview occasionally sized the watermark using the previous photo

changes.zh: 新增：更新说明改为从 GitHub 在线获取，今后补充说明不必等应用更新
changes.en: Added: the changelog is now fetched online from GitHub, so new entries no longer wait for an app update

changes.zh: 说明：无网络时，更新说明页显示随应用内置的快照（可能不是最新）
changes.en: Note: without a network connection the changelog page shows the snapshot bundled with the app, which may be out of date

title.zh: 预览所见，就是导出所得
title.en: What you preview is what you export

changes.zh: 修复：预览里调好的水印，导出后大小差出 7 倍以上（渲染基准坐标系没接上）
changes.en: Fixed: a watermark tuned in the preview came out over 7× smaller on export (the rendering base coordinate system was not linked up)

changes.zh: 修复：浅色背景图片的隐藏水印写进去了却读不出来（写入算法把改动抹平了）
changes.en: Fixed: hidden watermarks in light-background images were written but could not be read back (the write algorithm averaged the change away)

changes.zh: 修复：拖动字号 / 角度 / 密度 / 透明度时预览画面频闪
changes.en: Fixed: the preview flickered while dragging size, rotation, density or opacity

changes.zh: 修复：批量页预览卡顿、不跟手
changes.en: Fixed: the batch preview was laggy and did not keep up with the finger

changes.zh: 修复：图片稍大就提示「图片过大」而无法导出
changes.en: Fixed: slightly large images were rejected as too large and could not be exported

changes.zh: 修复：描边颜色的选择控件错位、相互重叠
changes.en: Fixed: the outline colour picker was misaligned and overlapping

changes.zh: 新增：批量导出前可先设定本次参数，不影响全局默认值
changes.en: Added: set per-run export parameters before a batch, without touching your global defaults

changes.zh: 新增：隐藏水印 DC-QIM 失真补偿，画质提升约 4.3 dB，提取率不降
changes.en: Added: DC-QIM distortion compensation for hidden watermarks — about 4.3 dB better quality at the same read rate

changes.zh: 新增：检测页「重新检测」，不必回相册重新选图
changes.en: Added: re-run detection on the Detect screen without picking the image again

changes.zh: 新增：检测不到水印时提示「这张图可能是用旧版本导出的」
changes.en: Added: when no watermark is found, a hint that the image may have been exported by an older version

changes.zh: 新增：导出设置区分「全局默认」与「本次参数」，并说明各自的作用范围
changes.en: Added: export settings now distinguish global defaults from per-export parameters, with the scope of each explained

changes.zh: 优化：预览分辨率自适应，内存占用约降一半，拖动更跟手
changes.en: Improved: adaptive preview resolution — roughly half the memory, and dragging keeps up

changes.zh: 优化：检测设置两两并排，文案精简（完整说明见各项 ⓘ）
changes.en: Improved: detection options paired two-per-row with tighter wording (full descriptions in the i popovers)

changes.zh: 优化：批量失败结果按原因分类展示，不再只有一个数字
changes.en: Improved: batch failures are grouped by reason instead of just a count

changes.zh: 说明：旧版本导出的图片可能检测不到水印 —— 那是写入缺陷，用新版本重新导出一次即可
changes.en: Note: images exported by older versions may not be detectable — that was a write-side defect; re-export with the new version and the watermark will be there

title.zh: 文案更准、无障碍可用、关于页加了构建信息
title.en: Clearer wording, accessible controls, build info in About

changes.zh: 关于页底部显示 Debug / Release 版与实际安装包名
changes.en: About page now shows the Debug / Release build type and the actual package name

changes.zh: 主创头像与昵称改为从 GitHub 实时获取（不必发版即可更新）
changes.en: Author avatar and nickname are fetched from GitHub at runtime

changes.zh: 无障碍：面板把手播报展开状态、页签播报选中、翻页圆点可读且更好点
changes.en: Accessibility: the panel handle announces its state, tabs announce selection, page dots are labelled and easier to tap

changes.zh: 代码质量：lint 历史欠账从 42 条清到 1 条
changes.en: Lint debt cut from 42 issues to 1

changes.zh: 文案改正：统一为「只下载、不上传」
changes.en: Wording corrected to downloads-only, never-uploads

title.zh: 隐藏水印大升级，交互全面做顺
title.en: A big invisible-watermark upgrade — and a smoother app all round

changes.zh: 隐藏水印新增 XMP 通道（EXIF 之外的第二个元数据容器）
changes.en: Invisible watermark gains an XMP channel (a second metadata container beside EXIF)

changes.zh: 隐藏水印带签名，检测时可验证「是否本应用导出」
changes.en: Invisible watermark is now signed — detection can tell whether the app wrote it

changes.zh: 两条隐藏水印通道可各自开关，按需取舍
changes.en: The two invisible channels can be switched on and off independently

changes.zh: 支持直角旋转：转过 90°/180°/270° 后仍能检出
changes.en: Right-angle rotation is handled: still detected after 90/180/270 degrees

changes.zh: 检测页可自选检测项：想快就快、想全就全
changes.en: Detection options: go fast or go thorough, your call

changes.zh: 新增使用教程（设置 → 其他 → 使用教程）
changes.en: New in-app tutorial (Settings → More → Tutorial)

changes.zh: 新增首页新手引导，可随时「重新过一遍」
changes.en: New home-screen onboarding that can be replayed any time

changes.zh: 隐藏水印按块自适应强度：同样抗压缩，画质更好
changes.en: Block-adaptive strength: same compression resistance, better image quality

changes.zh: 大图保护：内存放不下时明确提示，不再卡住
changes.en: Large-image guard: a clear message instead of freezing when memory is short

changes.zh: 界面说明统一收进 ⓘ 图标，参数面板更清爽
changes.en: Long explanations moved into the i icon — cleaner panels

changes.zh: 全面流畅度优化：拖动、翻页、切图、页面转场
changes.en: Smoother everywhere: dragging, paging, image switching, screen transitions

changes.zh: 导出设置拆分为「全局默认值」与「本次参数」
changes.en: Export settings split into global defaults and per-export parameters

changes.zh: 修复教程文档的 Markdown 渲染错误
changes.en: Fixed Markdown rendering errors in the tutorial

changes.zh: 修复拖动水印与参数面板时的卡顿感
changes.en: Fixed stutter when dragging the watermark and the parameter panel

title.zh: 预设可导出为文件 · 从文件导入

changes.zh: 预设页右上角新增菜单：可把全部预设导出成一个文件，或从文件导入预设
changes.en: New menu on the Presets screen: export all presets to a single file, or import presets from a file

changes.zh: 每个预设卡片新增导出按钮，可单独导出某一个预设
changes.en: Every preset card has an export button, so a single preset can be shared on its own

changes.zh: 导入时若名称重复会自动改名，不会覆盖已有预设
changes.en: Duplicate names are renamed automatically on import — existing presets are never overwritten

changes.zh: 导入完成后会提示结果（新增数量、自动改名数量）
changes.en: A summary reports how many presets were added and how many were renamed

changes.zh: 导出文件不含本机图片，导入图片预设后需重新选择一张 logo 图，其他参数均保留
changes.en: Exported files do not contain device-local images; image presets need a new logo after import (all other settings are preserved)

title.zh: 拖动定位水印 · 下载校验

changes.zh: 单个水印可以直接在预览图上拖动定位，不再局限于九宫格
changes.en: In single mode you can drag the watermark directly on the preview, no longer limited to the 3×3 grid

changes.zh: 应用内下载后校验安装包（SHA-256 + 包名 + 签名），不通过则拒绝安装
changes.en: In-app downloads are verified (SHA-256 + package name + signature); installation is refused if any check fails

changes.zh: 修复：对角线水印在长方形图片上覆盖不全
changes.en: Fixed: diagonal watermarks did not cover the whole of a landscape image

changes.zh: 修复：对角线改为整体斜铺、平铺改为逐字旋转，两个模式的旋转逻辑互换
changes.en: Fixed: diagonal now rotates the whole grid, tiled rotates each item — the two modes had their rotation logic swapped

changes.zh: 修复：单个模式在四角位置旋转时会甩出画面
changes.en: Fixed: in single mode, rotating a watermark placed at a corner threw it off-screen

title.zh: 中英双语 · 应用内检查更新

changes.zh: 支持中英文界面切换，可在「设置 → 其他 → 语言」中随时切换
changes.en: Chinese and English interface, switchable anytime under Settings → Other → Language

changes.zh: 新增「检查更新」：自动检测新版本，可直接跳转下载页
changes.en: Added "Check for updates": detects new versions and links to the download page

changes.zh: 支持应用内下载安装新版本（实验性，默认关闭，可在设置中开启）
changes.en: In-app download and install for new versions (experimental, off by default)

changes.zh: 更新说明现在能正确渲染 Markdown 格式（标题、列表、表格、代码块）
changes.en: Release notes now render Markdown correctly (headings, lists, tables, code blocks)

changes.zh: 导出目录统一为 Pictures/WatermarkBox（旧目录中的图片仍可正常读取）
changes.en: Export folder unified as Pictures/WatermarkBox (images in the old folder still readable)

changes.zh: 设置 → 其他 新增「更新说明」，可查看从 1.0.0 至今的全部变更
changes.en: Added a changelog under Settings → Other, listing every change since 1.0.0

changes.zh: 设置里「更新说明」与「关于」归入同一分组，样式统一
changes.en: Grouped Changelog and About together in Settings for a consistent look

title.zh: 预设可独立编辑 · 批量页大改

changes.zh: 首页右上角新增「水印预设」入口，可集中管理预设
changes.en: Added a presets entry in the top-right of the home screen for centralised management

changes.zh: 新增预设参数编辑页：不选图片也能直接改预设的名称与全部水印参数
changes.en: Added a preset editor: rename a preset and tweak every watermark parameter without picking an image first

changes.zh: 预设卡片新增编辑图标，重命名并入编辑页（少一个入口，少一次跳转）
changes.en: Added an edit icon on preset cards; renaming now lives in the editor (one less entry point and one less tap)

changes.zh: 修复保存同名预设时静默覆盖旧预设的问题（属数据丢失），现在会先询问保留 / 替换 / 取消
changes.en: Fixed presets being silently overwritten when saving under an existing name — a data-loss bug. You are now asked whether to keep both, replace, or cancel

changes.zh: 批量处理页整体重做，界面与单张编辑保持一致：同样的参数面板、可拖拽抽屉、同一套预设与导出设置
changes.en: Reworked the batch screen so it matches single-image editing: same parameter panel, draggable sheet, presets and export settings

changes.zh: 批量预览支持左右滑动切换图片，末页为「添加更多」，可继续追加图片
changes.en: Batch preview now supports swiping between images, with an "add more" page at the end

changes.zh: 修复批量预览无法滑动的问题：预览组件的手势会拦截横滑，现已在批量页让出手势
changes.en: Fixed batch preview not swiping at all — the preview component was swallowing horizontal gestures; it now yields them on the batch screen

changes.zh: 隐藏水印新增 DCT 频域开关：可单独控制是否写入频域，并明确标注其对画质的影响，由用户按场景自行取舍
changes.en: Added a DCT toggle for hidden watermarks, so frequency-domain embedding can be controlled separately; the effect on image quality is stated explicitly and left to your judgement

changes.zh: 设置中新增「开启隐藏水印时默认启用 DCT」选项
changes.en: Added a setting to enable DCT by default when turning on a hidden watermark

changes.zh: 设置页顶部新增分类菜单：水印 / 导出 / 其他
changes.en: Added category tabs at the top of Settings: Watermark / Export / Other

changes.zh: 新增「默认水印文字」设置：选图进编辑页时自动填入
changes.en: Added a default watermark text setting, prefilled when you open the editor

changes.zh: 新增「默认水印图」设置：选图进编辑页时自动载入该 logo
changes.en: Added a default watermark image setting, loaded automatically when you open the editor

changes.zh: 新增独立「关于」页：应用图标、版本、制作人（含头像与 QQ）、开源许可
changes.en: Added a standalone About screen: app icon, version, credits (avatar and QQ), and open-source license

changes.zh: 新增本次「更新说明」页
changes.en: Added this changelog screen

changes.zh: 保存预设遇到重名时，弹出「保留两者 / 替换 / 取消」确认框，替代此前的静默覆盖
changes.en: Saving a preset under an existing name now asks whether to keep both, replace, or cancel, instead of overwriting silently

changes.zh: 输入预设名称时实时检测重名并提示，不用点保存才知道
changes.en: Duplicate names are detected as you type, rather than only when you press save

title.zh: 隐藏水印溯源 · EXIF 保留

changes.zh: 新增隐藏水印功能：把溯源信息写入图片，包含 EXIF 元数据与 DCT 频域两条通道
changes.en: Added hidden watermarks: tracing data is written into the image through two channels — EXIF metadata and DCT frequency domain

changes.zh: 新增隐藏水印检测：可判断图片是否含本应用写入的隐藏水印
changes.en: Added hidden watermark detection to check whether an image carries one written by this app

changes.zh: 支持自定义隐藏水印内容，或自动使用「设备 ID + 时间戳」
changes.en: The hidden watermark content can be customised, or generated automatically from a device ID and timestamp

changes.zh: 导出时可选保留原图 EXIF 信息（拍摄时间、机型、GPS 等 35 项）
changes.en: Export can now preserve the original EXIF data (35 fields including capture time, camera model and GPS)

changes.zh: 修复隐藏水印使用中文时检测结果变成 ? 的问题（EXIF UserComment 的字符集编码限制）
changes.en: Fixed hidden watermarks containing Chinese characters being detected as "?" (a character-encoding limitation in the EXIF UserComment field)

title.zh: 批量处理 · 自定义字体

changes.zh: 新增批量处理：一次最多 50 张，后台处理并显示进度
changes.en: Added batch processing: up to 50 images at once, running in the background with a progress indicator

changes.zh: 支持导入自定义字体（ttf / otf / ttc）用于文字水印
changes.en: Added support for importing custom fonts (ttf / otf / ttc) for text watermarks

changes.zh: 新增水印预设：可保存常用配置并快速套用
changes.en: Added watermark presets for saving and reapplying common configurations

changes.zh: 文字水印支持 {filename} 等占位符
changes.en: Text watermarks now support placeholders such as {filename}

title.zh: 参数完善 · 导出设置

changes.zh: 文字水印支持字号、字体、加粗、斜体、描边、阴影、颜色
changes.en: Text watermarks gained size, font, bold, italic, stroke, shadow and colour

changes.zh: 支持单个 / 平铺 / 对角线三种布局，可调旋转与透明度
changes.en: Added single, tiled and diagonal layouts with adjustable rotation and opacity

changes.zh: 支持九宫格定位与边距调整
changes.en: Added 3×3 grid positioning with adjustable margins

changes.zh: 图片水印：可选择 logo、调整大小与位置
changes.en: Image watermarks: pick a logo and adjust its size and position

changes.zh: 新增导出设置：格式（PNG / JPEG）、质量、文件名模板、输出目录
changes.en: Added export settings: format (PNG / JPEG), quality, filename template and output folder
